title: Blowhorn - AI Native Social Media Management
registryDescription: Social media and marketing management: LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Bluesky, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, more
shortDescription: Not a bot. It's you. Social media and marketing management that grows replies, comments and real conversation, and posts, reposts and amplifies, on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Reddit, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Discord, Slack, GitHub and Hacker News.
longDescription:
Not a bot. It's you. Blowhorn is social media and marketing management for founders, DevRel, marketing managers, agencies and enterprises who need to be seen and heard wherever their audience is: LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Reddit, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Snapchat, Tumblr, Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, GitHub, Hacker News, Product Hunt, Dev.to, Hashnode, Medium and Substack.

Posting is only the start. What platforms care about most is engagement: replies, comments, real conversation and time spent with a post, early. Blowhorn puts its effort there. It helps you start and keep up conversations - replying, commenting and joining the discussion - as well as posting, reposting and amplifying what you and your team share. Teammates who opt in join in as themselves, so the conversation around a launch comes from real people, not a bot farm.

Your voice, at full volume. Blowhorn acts through your own profiles, on your own computers, at a human pace, under rules of engagement you set per platform, per profile and per activity. One shared calendar keeps every profile, brand and client in one place, with one picture of results.

You, everywhere you need to be, with your AI agent alongside. Through the hosted server at https://mcp.blowhorn.ai/mcp, an agent can review your activity and results. In the Blowhorn desktop app (requires Blowhorn 1.61.0 or later), it can also draft posts and replies and queue them for you. AI drafts, you decide:
- Nothing goes out until you approve it.
- Changes run as a dry run unless you confirm them.
- Results never include secrets.
